2014_spells.miniature-grasp.description: You conjure an invisible magical hand in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand can manipulate objects, open doors, and perform other tasks at your command.
2014_spells.miniature-grasp.effectSummar: Make a creature invisible until it attacks or the spell ends
2014_spells.miniature-grasp.fullDescript: Using 1 minute, the hand can manipulate objects, open doors, and perform other tasks at your command. You conjure an invisible magical hand in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The effect lasts for 8 hours.
